guidance.title: Backup guidance
guidance.blocked: This selection cannot start a backup
guidance.unavailable: Guidance is unavailable. Check the VM inventory and current checkpoint before submitting.
guidance.inventory_unknown: Refresh the agent inventory to obtain complete disk identities and capacities.
guidance.inventory_stale: The last VM inventory is at least ten minutes old. Check the agent’s inventory sync and refresh this view.
guidance.vm_absent: The source VM has disappeared from inventory. Open its replacement if you intend to protect the new VM.
guidance.provider_unknown: Confirm that this VM’s agent reports a supported backup method and refresh the inventory.
guidance.provider_offline: Check the agent heartbeat and its access to the hypervisor, then refresh this view.
guidance.scope_unconfirmed: Check that this VM’s namespace is in the agent’s installed and applied source selection.
guidance.identity_unknown: Refresh inventory to resolve the current VM and running instance identities.
guidance.domain_inactive: The native libvirt capture requires a running domain. Check its state before scheduling a backup.
guidance.vmi_stopped: This VM is stopped. KubeVirt capture requires a running, ready instance. Schedule backup for an approved running window.
guidance.vmi_not_ready: Check the current instance’s phase, Ready condition and assigned node. Refresh when the instance is running and ready.
guidance.vmi_paused: The instance is paused. Review the pause with the workload owner and wait for a healthy running window.
guidance.vmi_io_paused: A storage I/O error paused this instance. Investigate the source storage with the workload owner before requesting backup.
guidance.cbt_disabled: Changed Block Tracking is disabled. If your platform supports it, enable tracking for this VM and wait for an Enabled observation before requesting either backup mode.
guidance.cbt_pending: Tracking is initializing. Wait for the VM or running instance to report Enabled and refresh this view.
guidance.cbt_pending_restart: The VM reports that tracking needs a restart. Schedule an approved restart for this VM and verify that tracking becomes Enabled.
guidance.cbt_unknown: Check Changed Block Tracking on the current VM or running instance. Both KubeVirt backup modes require an Enabled observation.
guidance.invalid_selection: Keep at least one supported disk selected. Each exclusion must name a distinct target in the current inventory.
guidance.exclude_unsupported: Explicitly exclude the following unsupported disks before creating the backup.
guidance.no_persistent_disks: This VM has no PVC or DataVolume data disk to protect. Check where its application data is stored.
guidance.no_qcow2_disks: This domain has no supported qcow2 disk. Review the disk format with the libvirt administrator.
guidance.persistent_disk_unavailable: Verify that these persistent disks are bound, measurable and mapped as data disks. KubeVirt includes them in the native capture even when excluded from retained payloads.
guidance.disk_profile_required: Protect all persistent disks with this agent, or use an agent with the native-disk selection profile for a new full backup.
guidance.storage_at_limit: Restore free space on the agent filesystem before starting either mode. Preserve all active journals and held data.
guidance.storage_unmeasured: The agent could not measure its working filesystem. Verify its mount and access, then check the next heartbeat.
guidance.agent_full_only: The agent reports support for full backups only.
guidance.checkpoint_missing: Start a full backup to establish a baseline. The catalog has no current accepted checkpoint for this VM.
guidance.checkpoint_changed: Start a new full backup. The accepted checkpoint no longer matches the selected disks or current source.
guidance.checkpoint_recorded: The observed KubeVirt tracker and disk selection match the accepted checkpoint. At start, Vesta rechecks the source, chain, destination, encryption and available space.
guidance.tracker_unobserved: The agent could not confirm this VM’s backup tracker. Check its read access to this namespace and refresh the VM inventory.
guidance.tracker_conflict: The expected tracker is terminating or belongs to a different source. Ask the cluster administrator to reconcile its ownership before requesting a backup.
guidance.tracker_missing: The source VM’s tracker is absent even though the catalog records a checkpoint. Choose a new full backup to establish another baseline.
guidance.tracker_changed: The observed tracker identity or latest checkpoint differs from the catalog. Choose a new full backup for this source.
guidance.native_checkpoint_unverified: The catalog matches these disks. Native incremental capture checks the host checkpoint XML at startup. Choose a new full backup if the checkpoint is missing or has changed.
guidance.backup_api_missing: This cluster does not serve a required KubeVirt backup, tracker or export API. Check the platform’s supported backup feature set with the cluster administrator.
guidance.backup_api_unknown: The agent could not confirm the cluster’s backup, tracker and export APIs. Check API discovery access and refresh inventory.
guidance.capacity_limit: The {{role}} is {{amount}}% used. Its admission limit is {{limit}}%.
guidance.capacity_low: The {{role}} is {{amount}}% used. Check available space against the installation’s low-space warning.
guidance.multiple_disks: Snapshot evidence for these persistent disks
guidance.native_disks: KubeVirt captures all persistent disks in one VM backup operation. Disk exclusions select which payloads Vesta retains.
guidance.snapshot_yes: The VM controller reports individual snapshot support.
guidance.snapshot_no: The VM controller reports individual snapshots are unavailable.
guidance.snapshot_unknown: The VM controller supplied no individual snapshot evidence.
guidance.group_served: The cluster serves the CSI volume group snapshot API. Driver support for this disk set is unverified.
guidance.group_not_served: API discovery found no CSI volume group snapshot service for this cluster.
guidance.group_unknown: CSI volume group snapshot API discovery is inconclusive.
guidance.group_execution: Vesta’s current backup path does not execute an atomic CSI group snapshot.

help.label: Help
help.retention: Retention starts when a backup completes. Cleanup is separately enabled and protects backups needed by a retained chain. The default is 30 days.
help.backup_type: Full is the default. Incremental backup requires a usable full chain and provider support. KubeVirt also requires an observed Enabled CBT state and eligible bound PVC disks.
help.concurrency: Installation concurrent-backup limits and provider upload limits control parallel work. Per-backup worker overrides are unsupported. Scratch space is local to the selected provider or worker.
help.restore: Restore creates a fresh target. Choose a new name and confirm provider-specific storage and namespace mappings; an existing VM is not overwritten.
help.verification: Verification checks recorded backup integrity and the supported verification scope. It does not prove that a restored guest boots or that an application recovers.
help.storage: Select storage reachable by the backup provider. Check free capacity and provider scratch requirements; destination space and scratch space are separate.
help.schedule: A schedule runs only when enabled and enrolled with execution authorization. Retention follows completed backups; enabling cleanup is a separate choice.

operator_recovery.title: Requests awaiting review
operator_recovery.unknown: The outcome is unknown. The original request is retained. Inspect it below before taking further action.
operator_recovery.recovered: The original request was admitted. Review its metadata below; this action was not submitted again.
operator_recovery.unavailable: Secret delivery cannot be recovered. Inspect or revoke the identified credential, then deliberately create a replacement. For an agent candidate, cancel the pending candidate before staging another.
operator_recovery.no_record: No request was found at this moment. The outcome remains unknown; this does not authorize a replacement request ID.
operator_recovery.capability_error: Recovery capability could not be verified. Keep any original request identity; no new mutation was sent.
operator_recovery.storage_error: The request identity could not be saved. No request was submitted.
operator_recovery.scope_error: The signed-in identity changed. Review requests under the original account.
operator_recovery.unresolved: The original request is unresolved. Keep its identity and inspect again later.
operator_recovery.denied: Request inspection is unavailable. Keep the original identity and check access or connectivity.
operator_recovery.stage: The old agent key remains active. Save and install this candidate, then use the explicit activation helper on the agent host. Copying or closing this dialog does not activate it.
operator_recovery.cancel_confirm: Cancel this pending candidate? The active agent key remains unchanged.
operator_recovery.rotation_unavailable: This API does not advertise staged agent key activation. No rotation was submitted.
operator_recovery.activation_steps: Save the candidate in a private file with mode 0600. Stage the candidate in agent configuration without reloading the active agent. Run the explicit activation helper below, then perform the managed agent reload or restart and verify a fresh authenticated heartbeat.
operator_recovery.activation_tls: Replace API_ORIGIN and UUID values with this installation’s values. Use --ca-file PATH and, where required, --client-cert PATH --client-key PATH for verified TLS. The helper accepts the saved raw key or original JSON; do not pass a key on the command line.
operator_recovery.retry_confirm: Submit the re-entered intent once using the ORIGINAL request ID? An earlier request may already exist. This will never allocate a replacement ID.
operator_recovery.retry_reenter: To offer an original-ID retry, re-enter the same intent in its form and submit for inspection. No body or secret is restored from storage.
operator_recovery.dispatch_pending: Waiting for dispatch to the original agent.
operator_recovery.dispatch_dispatching: Agent handoff is in progress or its outcome is unknown. Inspect the original attempt.
operator_recovery.dispatch_held: Dispatch is held. Reconcile the original attempt before taking further action.
operator_recovery.dispatch_delivered: Dispatch processing finished. Check the job status for the result.
operator_recovery.dispatch_unknown: Dispatch status is unavailable. Inspect the original attempt.
